## Team Visualizations


```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(palmerpenguins)
```

### Eunice — \[Box Plot, e.g. "Flipper Length by Species"\]

```{r}
# Make your agreed-upon plot here, e.g.:
# penguins |> ggplot(aes(x = species, y = body_mass_g, fill = species)) + geom_boxplot()
penguins |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = species, y = flipper_length_mm, fill = species)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(
    x = "Species",
    y = "Flipper Length in mm",
    title = "Penguin Species vs Flipper Length",
    fill = "Species"
  )
```

\### Emil Chafigoulline — Body Mass vs Bill Length by Species

```{r}
penguins |> 
  ggplot(
    aes(x = body_mass_g, y = bill_length_mm)
  ) +
  geom_point(aes(color = species)) +
  theme_minimal()
```
